page_title: PAU 2-1 AUG | St. Pauli v Augsburg 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Danel Sinani and he is replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
90+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Half-chance! Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) plays a pass into the box, but Finn Dahmen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
88' Mathias Pereira Lage will be replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
86' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Here is a change. Fabian Rieder is going off and Sandro Wagner gives the last tactical orders to Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Han-Noah Massengo as he is replaced by Aiman Dardari (Augsburg).
82' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

82' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. St. Pauli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' Augsburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

77' 2 - 1 Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
76' Harm Osmers shows the yellow card to Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) for a heavy challenge.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Dzwigala departs the field of play to be replaced by Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli).
75' Mert Komur (Augsburg) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Nikola Vasilj.
74' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is penalised for holding. Harm Osmers signals a set piece.

72' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot towards the bottom left corner that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to pull off a marvellous diving save to keep his effort out.
69' Sandro Wagner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) replacing Marius Wolf.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elias Saad leaves the pitch and Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) comes on.
68' Elias Saad (Augsburg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Nikola Vasilj has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
67' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Harm Osmers ignores the protests.
65' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
63' Elias Saad (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Harm Osmers didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

62' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Nikola Vasilj easily catches the ball.
61' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.
58' Harm Osmers interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Joel Fujita (St. Pauli).

56' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
55' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) will take a corner kick.
53' Neat passing move from Augsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Elias Saad (Augsburg) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
47' A pass into the box finds Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Finn Dahmen denies him.
46' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) comes on the pitch for Arkadiusz Pyrka.
46' That will be all from Andreas Hountondji who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli).
45+256' Sandro Wagner (Augsburg) gets a yellow card, off the field.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Sandro Wagner is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kristijan Jakic suffers an injury and Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) comes on.
45+3' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 1 Goal! Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:1.
45' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Finn Dahmen who easily stops the effort.
45' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45' It’s a PENALTY to St. Pauli after the VAR review!

44' Play continues despite the shouts by some St. Pauli players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Harm Osmers interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
43' Surely that's handball by one of the Augsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
42' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
42' St. Pauli couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaped high and intercepted a cross. The ball goes out of play. St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
40' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
37' Augsburg are ruled offside.
36' A yellow card for a tackle by Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli). Harm Osmers doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
35' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
33' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will take a throw-in.
31' The St. Pauli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

28' Mert Komur (Augsburg) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
26' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) commits a foul and Harm Osmers immediately signals a free kick.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
23' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. St. Pauli will take a corner kick.
23' Harm Osmers blows his whistle as Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
21' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Augsburg was in an offside position.
16' 0 - 1 It's in! Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the right of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Han-Noah Massengo. 0:1.
14' A long pass, executed by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
11' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
10' St. Pauli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

6' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
5' St. Pauli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Harm Osmers is introduced as the referee for today's match.
